payload.name: Prompt Lab
payload.description: Prompts found on X, tried here for real. Share a prompt with its source link and credit; members run it themselves and post what actually came out, with the result file linked so anyone can open it.
payload.rules: 1. Credit the author and link the original post. 2. Only prompts the author shared word for word; no paraphrases. 3. A try links the real result file; never a description of one. 4. Say which model ran it and what you changed, if anything. 5. No invented numbers.
